description: Power through your workday with the DEWALT Heavy Duty True Wireless Earbuds – Black Edition. Designed for professionals who demand performance, durability, and style, these Bluetooth earbuds combine rugged jobsite toughness with modern convenience and crisp, immersive sound. Special Edition Black Colorway Make a bold statement on and off the jobsite with this special Black Edition. Sleek and professional, these earbuds are as sharp-looking as they are tough. All-Day Listening with 37+ Hours Battery Life With over 37 hours of total playtime, you can enjoy uninterrupted music and calls for multiple shifts. The included Type-C charging case keeps you powered up wherever the job takes you. Crystal Clear Calls in Loud Environments Take calls confidently in the harshest conditions thanks to Environmental Noise Control (ENC) technology, ensuring your voice stays clear—even against the background buzz of tools and traffic. Smart In-Ear Sensor Technology No need to fumble with your phone — these intelligent earbuds auto-pause your music when removed and resume playback when reinserted, so you never miss a beat during busy days. Built for Harsh Conditions Rated IPX6 for water and dust resistance, these rugged earbuds are made for sweaty workouts, dirty jobsites, and unpredictable outdoor conditions. DEWALT delivers rugged audio performance for those who work hard, play hard, and expect their gear to keep up. Whether you're on a construction site, landscaping, or simply enjoying music on the go — these true wireless earbuds are built to perform and built to last.
